verdict.rationale: Using a device as an extended second display is a fair question for a remote-desktop product, so the axis applies. The evidence pack has nothing on virtual displays or an extend mode. Community reports only describe picking which existing remote screen to view (rustdesk-comm-5, comm-25). That is adjacent multi-monitor viewing, not extending the desktop onto a tablet.

support.subject: As a power user, a tablet or spare device works as an additional display that extends the desktop, not only a mirror of it
